anomalies_and_limitations.description: Visible CSV header has 7 named fields, but data rows have 8 comma-separated fields. Field 0 is an exported dataframe index (1, 2, ...).
anomalies_and_limitations.impact: Field indexing must use explicit physical offset mapping rather than positional split by header length.
anomalies_and_limitations.mitigation: Physical column mapping is explicitly documented and enforced in C-A0 inventory.

anomalies_and_limitations.description: Source timestamps (e.g. '2015-02-04 17:51:00') are timezone-naive local clock readings without UTC offset.
anomalies_and_limitations.impact: Timestamps must not be assumed to be UTC or modified with 'Z'.
anomalies_and_limitations.mitigation: Preserved as SOURCE_ACQUISITION_CLOCK with UNVERIFIED timezone.

anomalies_and_limitations.description: Existing co2_occupancy_int8_v0.1.0.tflite model training script and dataset provenance are unverified in repository history.
anomalies_and_limitations.mitigation: Lineage C is explicitly separated from Lineage A (real raw source).

anomalies_and_limitations.description: Existing co2_scaling_metadata_v0.1.0.json recorded values do not match synthetic NPZ statistics or raw UCI feature means.
anomalies_and_limitations.impact: Scaler metadata source cannot be assumed to be the local UCI archive.
anomalies_and_limitations.mitigation: Lineage D is explicitly classified as FIT_DATA_LINEAGE_UNVERIFIED.

anomalies_and_limitations.description: Source dataset records office occupancy from a single room across 3 consecutive time periods.
anomalies_and_limitations.impact: Cross-building or multi-room generalization cannot be guaranteed from this dataset alone.
anomalies_and_limitations.mitigation: Dataset limitation explicitly documented for future C-A2 split design.
